_private.QuarticQuery.Bridge.Deferred.0..compiled_signature:
∀ {N w : ℕ} {A : QuarticQuery.AdaptiveProgram (Fin N) w} {T : ℕ} (s : QuarticQuery.FixedSim A T),
  (∀ (φ : QuarticQuery.State (Fin N) w), (Classical.choose ⋯) (s.embed φ) = s.entry (QuarticQuery.hadamard φ)) →
    ∀ (x : Fin N → Bool) (ψ : QuarticQuery.State (Fin N) w) (t : ℕ),
      Cslib.Quantum.run
          (fun t =>
            @_private.QuarticQuery.Bridge.Deferred.0.QuarticQuery.FixedSim.query.match_1
              (fun t => QuarticQuery.QState N s.W →ₗᵢ[ℂ] QuarticQuery.QState N s.W) t (fun _ => LinearIsometry.id)
              (fun _ =>
                (s.gate 0).comp
                  (Classical.choose
                    (_private.QuarticQuery.Bridge.Deferred.0.QuarticQuery.FixedSim.query._proof_1 N w A T s)))
              fun t => s.gate (t + 1))
          (s.embed (QuarticQuery.hadamard ψ)) x (t + 1) =
        Cslib.Quantum.run s.gate (s.entry (QuarticQuery.bitOracle x ψ)) x t
